title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 12: a song of thanksgiving, drawing water from the wells of salvation, and the Holy One of Israel great in Zion.

questions.text: According to verse 1, what has happened to Yahweh's anger?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 12:1 says that though Yahweh was angry, his anger has turned away and he comforts the speaker.

answers.text: It has fallen on the nations

questions.text: What two things does the speaker call Yah, Yahweh in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says that Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song, and he has become my salvation.

questions.text: Because God is his salvation, what does the speaker say he will do?
questions.explanation: The speaker says he will trust and will not be afraid, for God is his salvation.

questions.text: What will you draw with joy out of the wells of salvation?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

questions.text: Among whom are Yahweh's doings to be declared?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says to give thanks to Yahweh, call on his name, and declare his doings among the peoples.

questions.text: What is to be proclaimed about Yahweh's name?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 ends with the call to proclaim that his name is exalted.

answers.text: That his name is written in heaven
That his name is feared in Egypt

questions.text: Why does verse 5 say to sing to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says to sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things.

answers.text: For he has built the temple
For he has given rain in its season
For he has crowned a new king
For he has done excellent things

questions.text: Where should what Yahweh has done be made known?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says, "Let this be known in all the earth!"

questions.text: Who is told to cry aloud and shout?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 addresses the inhabitant of Zion: "Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion."

questions.text: Why should the inhabitant of Zion shout?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 gives the reason: the Holy One of Israel is great among you.

answers.text: For the harvest has been gathered
For the enemy has fled by night
For the king has returned in peace
For the Holy One of Israel is great among you
